meta.description: Compare 19 AI chains for spoken Swahili by answer quality and response time.
meta.og_description: Results for 19 AI chains tested on 24 spoken Swahili questions.

voice.text:
Habari! Mtoto wangu
ana homa. Nifanye nini?
voice.sub:
Hello! My child has a fever.
What should I do?

board.hint: Blue columns can run in your own country. The dashed line is the 10 s limit for phone calls.
board.note: Cost is the observed whole-workflow Gooey.AI charge across 24 benchmark runs per chain; every Swahili chain was charged the same rounded $0.04 per run. EcoCost estimates cover text-model inference only and exclude speech recognition and direct-audio inference. Sovereign-deployable: every step can run in your country or on your own servers, using open-weight models or, for Intron, speech recognition on local hardware. Private API: at least one step is only available from its maker’s cloud.

scatter.aria: Gemini 3.1 Pro with direct audio has the highest score and the fastest response.

score.front: Labelled: the best chain and the best sovereign-deployable one
score.note: Hover a point for a quick look, select it for details. Source: Gooey.AI, Aug 30, 2026.

cost.front: All 19 chains had the same observed rounded charge
cost.note: Arithmetic mean of 24 observed whole-workflow Gooey.AI charges per chain, normalized to 1,000 questions. Historical benchmark pricing, not a future-price guarantee. Source: public Gooey.AI run records, Aug 30, 2026.

carbon.front: Labelled best trade-offs among covered chains
carbon.note: EcoCost estimate from 24 runs per covered chain; low confidence. Speech recognition and direct-audio inference are excluded. Source: public Gooey.AI run records, Aug 30, 2026.

samples_intro: Three of the 24 questions, spoken in Swahili. Answers are from GPT-5.6 Sol with Omnilingual, each graded against a reference answer.
